knowledge:
- key_parameters: transform=In normaliseExprs(), specifies the transformation method (e.g., "log" for HTO/ADT log-transformation, "zi_minMax" for zero-inflated min-max scaling of ADT, or "minMax" for RNA scaling) ;; minPts=In withinSampleDoublets(), sets the minimum points parameter for DBSCAN-based within-sample doublet detection ;; K=In spectralClustering(), specifies the number of clusters to compute or evaluate ;; altExp_name=In DEgenes() and normaliseExprs(), specifies the alternative expression slot to use (e.g., "ADT", "HTO", or "none" for RNA) ;; use_alt_exp=In ligandReceptorTest(), a logical indicating whether to use alternative expression (ADT) to predict receptor expression
- alternatives: spectralClustering vs igraphClustering=spectralClustering performs spectral clustering on the fused similarity matrix, whereas igraphClustering allows community detection algorithms like Louvain or Walktrap via the igraph package ;; ADT-based vs RNA-based ligand-receptor testing=ligandReceptorTest() can predict receptor expression using cell surface protein expression (ADT) when use_alt_exp = TRUE, or fall back to RNA expression only when altExp_name = "RNA"
- when_to_use: Use this package when analyzing single-cell CITE-seq datasets that contain matched single-cell RNA-seq, cell surface protein expression (ADT), and optionally sample multiplexing hashtags (HTO).
- pitfalls: Ensure cell names are perfectly matched across RNA, ADT, and HTO matrices before running preprocessing() ;; Doublet detection must be performed sequentially (cross-sample first, then within-sample) and doublets must be filtered out before running CiteFuse() integration ;; Normalization methods must be chosen carefully depending on the downstream task (e.g., ligand-receptor analysis requires minMax and zi_minMax scaling rather than standard log-normalization).

workflows.name: preprocessing_doublets_integration
workflows.intent: Preprocess raw CITE-seq matrices, perform step-wise doublet detection, integrate RNA and ADT modalities using Similarity Network Fusion (SNF), and cluster cells.
workflows.stages: 1. Preprocess raw matrices into a SingleCellExperiment object using preprocessing() ;; 2. Normalize HTO expression using normaliseExprs() ;; 3. Run dimensional reduction on HTO using runTSNE() or runUMAP() ;; 4. Detect cross-sample doublets using crossSampleDoublets() ;; 5. Detect within-sample doublets using withinSampleDoublets() ;; 6. Filter out doublets from the SingleCellExperiment object ;; 7. Normalize RNA and ADT expression ;; 8. Integrate modalities using CiteFuse() ;; 9. Cluster cells using spectralClustering() or igraphClustering() ;; 10. Visualize joint dimensional reduction using reducedDimSNF() and visualiseDim()
workflows.code:
sce_citeseq <- preprocessing(CITEseq_example)
sce_citeseq <- normaliseExprs(sce = sce_citeseq, altExp_name = "HTO", transform = "log")
sce_citeseq <- scater::runTSNE(sce_citeseq, altexp = "HTO", name = "TSNE_HTO", pca = TRUE)
visualiseDim(sce_citeseq, dimNames = "TSNE_HTO") + labs(title = "tSNE (HTO)")
sce_citeseq <- scater::runUMAP(sce_citeseq, altexp = "HTO", name = "UMAP_HTO")
visualiseDim(sce_citeseq, dimNames = "UMAP_HTO") + labs(title = "UMAP (HTO)")
sce_citeseq <- crossSampleDoublets(sce_citeseq)
table(sce_citeseq$doubletClassify_between_label)
table(sce_citeseq$doubletClassify_between_class)
visualiseDim(sce_citeseq, dimNames = "TSNE_HTO", colour_by = "doubletClassify_between_label")
plotHTO(sce_citeseq, 1:4)
sce_citeseq <- withinSampleDoublets(sce_citeseq, minPts = 10)
table(sce_citeseq$doubletClassify_within_label)
table(sce_citeseq$doubletClassify_within_class)
visualiseDim(sce_citeseq, dimNames = "TSNE_HTO", colour_by = "doubletClassify_within_label")
sce_citeseq <- sce_citeseq[, sce_citeseq$doubletClassify_within_class == "Singlet" & sce_citeseq$doubletClassify_between_class == "Singlet"]
sce_citeseq <- scater::logNormCounts(sce_citeseq)
sce_citeseq <- normaliseExprs(sce_citeseq, altExp_name = "ADT", transform = "log")
sce_citeseq <- CiteFuse(sce_citeseq)
SNF_W_clust <- spectralClustering(metadata(sce_citeseq)[["SNF_W"]], K = 20)
plot(SNF_W_clust$eigen_values)
which.max(abs(diff(SNF_W_clust$eigen_values)))
SNF_W_clust <- spectralClustering(metadata(sce_citeseq)[["SNF_W"]], K = 5)
sce_citeseq$SNF_W_clust <- as.factor(SNF_W_clust$labels)
SNF_W1_clust <- spectralClustering(metadata(sce_citeseq)[["ADT_W"]], K = 5)
sce_citeseq$ADT_clust <- as.factor(SNF_W1_clust$labels)
SNF_W2_clust <- spectralClustering(metadata(sce_citeseq)[["RNA_W"]], K = 5)
sce_citeseq$RNA_clust <- as.factor(SNF_W2_clust$labels)
sce_citeseq <- reducedDimSNF(sce_citeseq, method = "tSNE", dimNames = "tSNE_joint")
g1 <- visualiseDim(sce_citeseq, dimNames = "tSNE_joint", colour_by = "SNF_W_clust") + labs(title = "tSNE (SNF clustering)")
g2 <- visualiseDim(sce_citeseq, dimNames = "tSNE_joint",  colour_by = "ADT_clust") + labs(title = "tSNE (ADT clustering)")
g3 <- visualiseDim(sce_citeseq, dimNames = "tSNE_joint",  colour_by = "RNA_clust") + labs(title = "tSNE (RNA clustering)")
library(gridExtra)
grid.arrange(g3, g2, g1, ncol = 2)
SNF_W_louvain <- igraphClustering(sce_citeseq, method = "louvain")
table(SNF_W_louvain)
sce_citeseq$SNF_W_louvain <- as.factor(SNF_W_louvain)
visualiseDim(sce_citeseq, dimNames = "tSNE_joint", colour_by = "SNF_W_louvain") + labs(title = "tSNE (SNF louvain clustering)")
visualiseKNN(sce_citeseq, colour_by = "SNF_W_louvain")

workflows.name: downstream_analytics
workflows.intent: Perform differential expression analysis, evaluate ADT importance, construct gene-ADT networks, and test ligand-receptor interactions.
input: sce_integrated.rds (SingleCellExperiment object containing integrated RNA and ADT data, with cluster labels)
workflows.stages: 1. Perform differential expression analysis for RNA and ADT using DEgenes() and selectDEgenes() ;; 2. Visualize DE results using DEbubblePlot() and DEcomparisonPlot() ;; 3. Evaluate ADT importance using importanceADT() and visualize with visImportance() ;; 4. Construct gene-ADT correlation network using geneADTnetwork() ;; 5. Normalize modalities for ligand-receptor analysis and run ligandReceptorTest() ;; 6. Visualize ligand-receptor interactions using visLigandReceptor()
workflows.code:
sce_citeseq <- DEgenes(sce_citeseq, altExp_name = "none", group = sce_citeseq$SNF_W_louvain, return_all = TRUE, exprs_pct = 0.5)
sce_citeseq <- selectDEgenes(sce_citeseq, altExp_name = "none")
sce_citeseq <- DEgenes(sce_citeseq, altExp_name = "ADT", group = sce_citeseq$SNF_W_louvain, return_all = TRUE, exprs_pct = 0.5)
sce_citeseq <- selectDEgenes(sce_citeseq, altExp_name = "ADT")
rna_DEgenes <- metadata(sce_citeseq)[["DE_res_RNA_filter"]]
adt_DEgenes <- metadata(sce_citeseq)[["DE_res_ADT_filter"]]
rna_DEgenes <- lapply(rna_DEgenes, function(x){
  x$name <- gsub("hg19_", "", x$name)
  x})
DEbubblePlot(list(RNA = rna_DEgenes, ADT = adt_DEgenes))
rna_list <- c("hg19_CD4", "hg19_CD8A", "hg19_HLA-DRB1", "hg19_ITGAX", "hg19_NCAM1", "hg19_CD27", "hg19_CD19")
adt_list <- c("CD4", "CD8", "MHCII (HLA-DR)", "CD11c", "CD56", "CD27", "CD19")
rna_DEgenes_all <- metadata(sce_citeseq)[["DE_res_RNA"]]
adt_DEgenes_all <- metadata(sce_citeseq)[["DE_res_ADT"]]
feature_list <- list(RNA = rna_list, ADT = adt_list)
de_list <- list(RNA = rna_DEgenes_all, ADT = adt_DEgenes_all)
DEcomparisonPlot(de_list = de_list, feature_list = feature_list)
set.seed(2020)
sce_citeseq <- importanceADT(sce_citeseq, group = sce_citeseq$SNF_W_louvain, subsample = TRUE)
visImportance(sce_citeseq, plot = "boxplot")
visImportance(sce_citeseq, plot = "heatmap")
sort(metadata(sce_citeseq)[["importanceADT"]], decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]
RNA_feature_subset <- unique(as.character(unlist(lapply(rna_DEgenes_all, "[[", "name"))))
ADT_feature_subset <- unique(as.character(unlist(lapply(adt_DEgenes_all, "[[", "name"))))
geneADTnetwork(sce_citeseq, RNA_feature_subset = RNA_feature_subset, ADT_feature_subset = ADT_feature_subset, cor_method = "pearson", network_layout = igraph::layout_with_fr)
data("lr_pair_subset", package = "CiteFuse")
sce_citeseq <- normaliseExprs(sce = sce_citeseq, altExp_name = "ADT", transform = "zi_minMax")
sce_citeseq <- normaliseExprs(sce = sce_citeseq, altExp_name = "none", exprs_value = "logcounts", transform = "minMax")
sce_citeseq <- ligandReceptorTest(sce = sce_citeseq, ligandReceptor_list = lr_pair_subset, cluster = sce_citeseq$SNF_W_louvain, RNA_exprs_value = "minMax", use_alt_exp = TRUE, altExp_name = "ADT", altExp_exprs_value = "zi_minMax", num_permute = 1000)
visLigandReceptor(sce_citeseq, type = "pval_heatmap", receptor_type = "ADT")
visLigandReceptor(sce_citeseq, type = "pval_dotplot", receptor_type = "ADT")
visLigandReceptor(sce_citeseq, type = "group_network", receptor_type = "ADT")
visLigandReceptor(sce_citeseq, type = "group_heatmap", receptor_type = "ADT")
visLigandReceptor(sce_citeseq, type = "lr_network", receptor_type = "ADT")

workflows.name: between_sample_analysis
workflows.intent: Compare gene/protein expression and perform differential expression across different samples or conditions.
workflows.stages: 1. Compare expression across samples using visualiseExprsList() ;; 2. Perform cross-sample differential expression using DEgenesCross() ;; 3. Select significant cross-sample DE genes using selectDEgenes()
workflows.code:
visualiseExprsList(sce_list = list(control = sce_citeseq, ctcl = sce_ctcl_subset), plot = "boxplot", altExp_name = "none", exprs_value = "logcounts", feature_subset = c("hg19_S100A10", "hg19_CD8A"), group_by = c("SNF_W_louvain", "SNF_W_louvain"))
visualiseExprsList(sce_list = list(control = sce_citeseq, ctcl = sce_ctcl_subset), plot = "boxplot", altExp_name = "ADT", feature_subset = c("CD19", "CD8"), group_by = c("SNF_W_louvain", "SNF_W_louvain"))
de_res <- DEgenesCross(sce_list = list(control = sce_citeseq, ctcl = sce_ctcl_subset), colData_name = c("SNF_W_louvain", "SNF_W_louvain"), group_to_test = c("2", "6"))
de_res_filter <- selectDEgenes(de_res = de_res)
de_res_filter
